Check out the PCB used for this project here 👉 https://www.pcbway.com/project/shareproject/Flatbox_Mini_WASD_38dac5d6.html

Switch 2 clamshell v2. The goal here was to be a portable fightpad/leverless controller for the Switch 2 that uses MAGNETS to hold the Switch 2 tablet in there. This was a 3D printed project that takes some soldering as well.

Project on Github: CHECK BACK LATER TODAY
